listing.name: The Knights of Ludd
listing.summary: An ambitious expansion for the sector's holy defenders and their unholy enemies.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new faction with hand-crafted star systems, diverse boss fights, and advanced custom AI.

description:
Requires LunaLib, LazyLib, GraphicsLib, and MagicLib


download   
DonateAll donations go towards improving the mod!

Featuring:
Hand-crafted star systems!
A diverse lineup of boss fights!
Advanced custom AI!
Innovative campaign and combat gameplay!
Corporate hubris!
modder hubris
And much more!

<COMSEC REDACTED>

FAQ
 Can the mod be added to existing games? 
 Yes it can! 
 Is it good? 
 It's really good. We worked really hard and are very proud of it. 
 Are the ships OP? 
 The ships have higher power density than most in their classes, but their FP/maintenance costs reflect this. Fewer stronger ships means the armor modules don't negatively impact performance or balance. 
 Are there quests? 
 We've included an expansive breadcrumb storyline to discover and we're working on formal quests. 
 Are there boss fights? 
 Thanks for asking! There are multiple boss fights of escalating difficulty. 
 Where should I start the storyline? 
 The Knights have stations in Canaan and Eos Exodus. The characters there can get you pointed in the right direction. 
 Can the mod be added to existing games? 
 Yes it can! 
 Do I need a good PC to play Knights of Ludd? 
 KOL scripts are efficient but ambitious and layered. We recommend budgeting 300MB of VRAM for the mod. 
 Where can I get it? 
Follow the link that says "Get it here:" and you'll be on the path.

Credits
- Sprites: Selkie, SnazzyPantsMcgee, Pyrophage
- Code: Dal, Starficz, Lukas04, President Matt Damon

- Weapons: SkylordZero, SnazzyPantsMcGee
- VFX: Selkie, Amazigh, President Matt Damon, Starficz, Dal, Himemi, Wisp, NiaTahl
- Portraits (Human): Stable Diffusion using GhostMix checkpoint and Severian-Void's Starsector checkpoint.
- Portraits (AI): Selkie (ironic, right?)
- Other Art contributions: SnazzyPantsMcGee, Nes, Quacken, Pyrophage, Sleepyfish, Alfonzo, NiaTahl, Dal, CitizenJoe
- Other Code contributions: Lukas04, NiaTahl, CeruleanPancake

- Writing: Wisp, Dal, Alfonzo, Candlebury, WMGreywind
- Sound: Mesotronik
- Music: Haplogynae

- Special Thanks : Amazigh, Timid, Pogre, Sirhartley, SnazzyPantsMcGee, 
- Tartiflette : Stellar backgrounds, Seeker & Torchship art, shield and boss code reference
- Dark.Revenant : Terrain code reference

May Ludd guide you.
